title: No check makes the DHW shortfall penalty bind; its max->min price base is unseen
claim: Mutant 0911281eca895664 at dhw_planner.py:1559 survives the full gate (SURVIVED), yet the probe's delta_kwh moves: baseline dhw_kwh=2.5056 kWh, mutant dhw_kwh=1.9948 kWh.
mechanism: Reach: production admits the price vector (no clamp); separation needs a price spread of >=8000 per kWh with a near-free step. Check that should have failed (D3.M4): tests/features.py _plan_dhw_min_cost cases (~63150, 63611, 63732) never use a spread large enough to make the shortfall penalty bind.
